name: HEALTH_AGENT_RECEIPT_OBSERVED_20261107
comment: stored its review (status stored, 3271 chars, exit 0, ok_at set) and was graded DEGRADED because
its receipt summary carried a top-level 'pipeline_failed: 13'. lib.run_quality.receipt_flags reads
any summary key ending in 'failed' as THIS RUN's failure count, so the pipeline failures the review
observed read as 13 reviews that failed — the same subject-counter class the reader already handles
for stale/degraded. The receipt now states the lane's own outcome at the top level and what it
observed under 'observed', keeping the count, the 24 h window and the pipelines that failed; it also
names those pipelines (GROUP BY pipeline_key), so a bare number becomes evidence. Nothing is muted:
status/no_response/store_failed still drive the exit code and ok_at. Hermetic: synthetic cursors,
no DB, no model, no network.
